user.title: GitHub access
user.description: Homerunner watches all repositories of an organisation or user for jobs waiting on your self-hosted runners. The token needs read access to Actions (and read and write if you want to dispatch workflows with it).

data_description.api_base: Only change this for GitHub Enterprise Server.
data_description.excluded_repos: Repository names (without owner) that are ignored.
data_description.runner_labels: A job counts if all of its labels are in this list.

server.title: Runner server
server.description: Connection to the server's BMC (Redfish) and to the guard script on the host (SSH). If you leave the SSH host key empty, it is fetched and you can confirm it on the next page.

data_description.bmc_host: Host name or IP address of the BMC.
data_description.wol_mac: Optional second way to wake the server.
data_description.ssh_private_key: Private key (PEM or OpenSSH format, without passphrase) of the guard user.
data_description.ssh_host_key: Optional public host key line. Leave empty to pin the key on first use.

host_key.title: Confirm the SSH host key
host_key.description:
{host} presented this host key. Confirm that it is the key of your server; it is pinned and checked on every connection.

`{host_key}`

reauth_confirm.title: Renew the GitHub token
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {owner} was rejected. Enter a new one.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the server
reconfigure.description: Connection to the server's BMC (Redfish) and to the guard script on the host (SSH). The settings are checked like during setup. If you leave the SSH host key empty, it is fetched again and you can confirm it on the next page.

data_description.bmc_host: Host name or IP address of the BMC.
data_description.wol_mac: Optional second way to wake the server.
data_description.ssh_private_key: Private key (PEM or OpenSSH format, without passphrase) of the guard user.
data_description.ssh_host_key: Optional public host key line. Leave empty to pin the key on first use.

reconfigure_host_key.title: Confirm the SSH host key
reconfigure_host_key.description:
{host} presented this host key. Confirm that it is the key of your server; it is pinned and checked on every connection.

`{host_key}`

error.forbidden: The token lacks the required permissions or the rate limit is exhausted.
error.owner_not_found: This organisation or user does not exist or is not visible to the token.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the log for details.
error.invalid_ssh_key: The SSH private key cannot be read (a key with passphrase is not supported).
error.invalid_auth_bmc: The BMC rejected the user name or password.
error.cannot_connect_bmc: Cannot reach the BMC or it does not speak Redfish.
error.cannot_connect_guard: Cannot connect to the guard over SSH. Check host, key and that the guard script is installed.
error.guard_protocol_error: The SSH command answered, but not like the guard script.

user.title: Add schedule
user.description: Dispatch a workflow at fixed times and wake the server beforehand.

data_description.workflow: File name (for example nightly.yml) or workflow id.
data_description.inputs: A JSON object with the workflow inputs, or empty.
data_description.dispatch_token: Optional. Defaults to the access token of the integration.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure schedule
reconfigure.description: Dispatch a workflow at fixed times and wake the server beforehand.

data_description.workflow: File name (for example nightly.yml) or workflow id.
data_description.inputs: A JSON object with the workflow inputs, or empty.
data_description.dispatch_token: Optional. Defaults to the access token of the integration.

error.invalid_inputs: The inputs must be a valid JSON object.

init.title: Rules and filters
init.description: The idle timers can also be changed with the number entities. If the webhook is enabled, GitHub must send workflow_job events to `{webhook_url}` with the secret `{webhook_secret}`.

data_description.use_webhook: Optional accelerator. Polling stays active as a safety net.

webhook_info.title: GitHub webhook
webhook_info.description:
Create a webhook at GitHub (organisation or repository settings) for the event "Workflow jobs", content type application/json.

Payload URL: `{webhook_url}`

Secret: `{webhook_secret}`

wake.name: Wake server
wake.description: Powers the server on regardless of the automatic setting.

config_entry.name: Configuration entry
config_entry.description: Only needed if several servers are configured.

shutdown.name: Shut down server
shutdown.description: Shuts the server down through the guard script, which refuses while a job runs.

force.name: Force
force.description: Power the server off through the BMC without asking the guard. Running jobs are lost.

config_entry.name: Configuration entry
config_entry.description: Only needed if several servers are configured.

keep_awake.name: Keep server awake
keep_awake.description: Prevents automatic shutdowns for a while.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the server is kept on.

config_entry.name: Configuration entry
config_entry.description: Only needed if several servers are configured.

dispatch.name: Dispatch workflow
dispatch.description: Dispatches a workflow, either of a schedule or of any repository.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: A schedule entity or the id of a schedule.

repository.name: Repository
repository.description: Owner/name, if no schedule is given.

workflow.name: Workflow
workflow.description: File name or id, if no schedule is given.

ref.name: Branch or tag
ref.description: Overrides the reference of the schedule.

inputs.name: Inputs
inputs.description: Overrides the inputs of the schedule.

config_entry.name: Configuration entry
config_entry.description: Only needed if several servers are configured.

token_invalid.title: GitHub token rejected
token_invalid.description: Dispatching {repository} for the schedule {schedule} failed because GitHub rejected the token. Renew the token in the integration or in the schedule settings.

multiple_entries.message: Several Homerunner entries exist; select one with config_entry.

invalid_inputs.message: The inputs must be a JSON object.

dispatch_target_missing.message: Give either a schedule or both repository and workflow.
